topic: Could the hybrid feeding structure introduce scalability challenges in dynamic payload power allocation for large-scale arrays?
consensus_response: The hybrid feeding structure introduces scalability challenges due to increased insertion losses and mutual coupling as array size grows, reducing efficiency. Optimizing the hybrid feeding topology and employing adaptive power allocation techniques can mitigate these issues, enhancing flexibility and balancing load distribution.
reference_context: SatCom systems face scalability challenges due to insertion losses and mutual coupling, affecting efficiency and performance.
